title: 10:16-18 kindle a burning/burning of a fire/fire/flame/burn and devour/consume. Isa. 10:16-18 describes the manner in which the forests and trees (representative of people, and here specifically of ancient Assyria as well as the wicked world of the last days) will be destroyed when Jesus comes with fire and burning. The forest-fire imagery parallels the section of Isaiah (10:33-34) in which God, as the forester, cuts down the forest of Assyria with his mighty ax.
author: Tina M. Peterson
